What this release supports. The page is generated from the constants the tax rules and the plugin's startup
check read, so it cannot claim more than the code accepts.

## Seller and buyers

The seller is established in Germany: the VAT rules, rates and invoice requirements applied are German. A
seller established elsewhere stops the plugin at startup (`UNSUPPORTED_SELLER_COUNTRY`).

| Seller — tax rules | Buyer                                                                                          | Document                                                                    | Delivery               | Since |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----- |
| 🇩🇪 Germany         | 🇩🇪 Business or consumer in Germany                                                             | ZUGFeRD / Factur-X, `EN 16931` profile — or XRechnung 3.0, if you prefer it | File: XML, or PDF/A-3b | 0.1.0 |
| 🇩🇪 Germany         | 🇩🇪 Public-sector buyer in Germany, with a Leitweg-ID                                           | XRechnung 3.0                                                               | File: XML, or PDF/A-3b | 0.1.0 |
| 🇩🇪 Germany         | 🇪🇺 Any other EU member state, except Italy and Poland; Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway (EEA) | ZUGFeRD / Factur-X, `EN 16931` profile                                      | File: XML, or PDF/A-3b | 0.1.0 |
| 🇩🇪 Germany         | 🇨🇭 🇬🇧 Switzerland and the UK                                                                   | ZUGFeRD / Factur-X, `EN 16931` profile                                      | File: XML, or PDF/A-3b | 0.1.0 |

**Not supported:** 🇮🇹 Italy (SDI), 🇵🇱 Poland (KSeF) —
clearance platforms with an XML of their own, which no EN 16931 document can serve; out of scope. A buyer
anywhere else, and a seller outside Germany, are refused too.

A buyer in Italy or Poland is refused as `UNSUPPORTED_BUYER_COUNTRY_CLEARANCE`, any other unsupported buyer as
`UNSUPPORTED_BUYER_COUNTRY`.

Which document a buyer receives, and why: [`tax-semantics.md`](tax-semantics.md).

## Territories with a VAT treatment of their own

These addresses carry an ordinary country code, but the territory's VAT treatment is not that country's. They
are recognised by postcode and refused (`SPECIAL_VAT_TERRITORY`) rather than invoiced with the wrong
category.
Northern Ireland is refused for goods only; a service there is taxed as in the
country its code names.

| Country code | Territory                                 | Why                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| DE           | Heligoland                                | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| DE           | Büsingen am Hochrhein                     | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| ES           | The Canary Islands                        | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| ES           | Ceuta                                     | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| ES           | Melilla                                   | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| FI           | The Åland Islands                         | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| FR           | A French overseas department or territory | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| GR           | Mount Athos                               | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| IT           | Livigno                                   | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| IT           | Campione d'Italia                         | outside the EU VAT area although part of an EU member state                          |
| GB, XI       | Northern Ireland                          | inside the EU VAT area for goods under the Windsor Framework although part of the UK |

## Delivery

Every document is a file stored with the order: the CII XML, or a PDF/A-3b with the XML embedded when a PDF
is configured. It is downloaded from Medusa Admin, or by the customer through the Store API. Nothing is sent
through a network such as Peppol.

What comes next, country by country: the [country roadmap](../README.md#country-roadmap).
